_readme: dsh hooks for the multi-window-m-035 skill (方案 B: dsh as a first-class host).
Mount the Claude Code bridge, NOT the Codex bridge: only this dialect exposes
SubagentStop, which is the 'a delegated window ended' signal this skill needs.
The Codex bridge silently drops SubagentStart/SubagentStop.
(a relative configPath resolves from the directory that launched dsh)
Every command below must exit 0. dsh's Stop hook is a serial listener whose
blocking result forces another model turn; stop_hook_active is always false and
the consecutive-block cap is not implemented, so a blocking hook would loop.
dsh-hook-bridge.py therefore always exits 0 and only writes evidence.
